messages:
anya: Heads-up 1: I put a first-pass release-notes draft for 0.13.0 in the staging branch. Main callouts: routing hints GA, batching fix, and a note on embedding stability. Need snippet parity and a short migration blurb for teams that pinned variants. Preview: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/changelog/0.13.0-draft
kevin: Thanks. I'll sync Node + Python SDK snippets. Do we want to show both a simple and an advanced example?
maria: Simple + advanced is good. I'll keep the simple one in quickstart and put the advanced, explain-the-fields example in the migration guide. Samir, can you confirm whether kv-cache behaviour changed for long-context in this patch?
samir: Confirmed: kv-cache restore now skips zero-length frames which fixes a grow-until-OOM case. There
is still an edge with rerankers on >10k tokens where chunk boundaries can drop trailing tokens. Filed repro: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/448
kevin: Proposed quickstart Node snippet (simple):
```js
// quickstart: routing hint simple
const out = await client.generate({
  model: 'redwood-adaptive-2',
  prompt: 'Explain HTTP caching in plain terms',
  routing_hint: 'latency',
});
```

And an advanced variant with weights:
```js
// advanced routing weights
const res = await client.generate({
  model: 'redwood-adaptive-2',
  prompt: '...',
  routing_hint: { preference: 'latency', weights: { latency: 0.8, cost: 0.2 }, fallback: 'cheapest' }
});
```
maria: Nice. For Python please prefer dict-style for the advanced example so it reads naturally. I'll embed both. Also reminder: include a small note that 'fallback: cheapest' may throttle throughput depending on reserved capacity.
leo: Quick link-fix request: there are three anchor links in the migration guide that point to old headings after the last docs restructuring. I'll do a pass and push a tiny follow-up PR.
anya: Cool. Docs-bot: please remind authors to add the 'changelog' label and a 1-2 bullet 'release-notes' snippet file under docs/release-notes/.
docs-bot: Reminder posted: please add a release-notes snippet <= 2 bullets and tag the PR with 'changelog'.
render-bot: Staging render succeeded: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/changelog/0.13.0-draft 1:37: render id 78a1 1:37
kevin: FYI I found a minor wording nit in the quickstart that changes the example output expectations. I'll update the comment and push.
samir: For the known-issues section I'd add two bullets: (1) reranker truncation repro linked above, (2) short burst quota math: console per-token estimate can be noisy for the first few minutes after a capacity spike.
maria: Adding both. Also adding an 'upgrade checklist' subsection: pin variant, test canary, monitor token metrics for 24h.
anya: Final checklist: Kevin -> open SDK PR with both snippets and tests; Maria -> PR for migration guide + anchor sweep; Leo -> anchor fixes PR; Samir -> attach repro to GH issue and add test case. If all green we merge changelog + release-notes snippet tomorrow AM. :rocket:
kevin: Will do, ETA tonight.
maria: Draft PR ready in ~90m.
samir: I'll upload the unit repro and tests in a follow-up commit.
anya: Thanks team 1: tagging @kevin @maria @samir @leo for follow-up.
